title: Auto farm speed | Auto farm hoops | More!

[ + ] Auto Farm Speed (Red, Orange, Blue, Ethereal Orbs)

[ + ] Auto Farm Gems (Gem, Infernal Gem)

[ + ] Auto Farm XP (Yellow Orbs)

[ + ] Auto Farm Hoops (teleports through each hoop)

[ + ] Auto Claim Free Gifts

[ + ] Teleport to courses (Grass, Frost, Pirate, Parkour)

[ + ] Teleport to caves (Mysterious, Inferno, Electro, Jungle)

[ + ] Teleport to all 10 crystal/egg locations

[ + ] Teleport to all reward chests

[ + ] Fly (WASD + Space/Shift)

[ + ] Noclip

[ + ] Anti-AFK
